one_line: Sarvāstivāda scholar Vasumitra and poet-philosopher Ashvaghosha at a Kushan‑era Buddhist council in Kashmir-Gandhara.

appearance.age_look: Vasumitra appears as a lean monk in his late 40s; Ashvaghosha as a slightly younger, calm scholar in his late 30s with a refined build.
appearance.face: Vasumitra has an oval face, light brown Gandharan complexion, sharp nose, thin lips, and thoughtful, narrow eyes with a quietly intense default expression; Ashvaghosha has a softer oval face, medium brown Indian complexion, fuller lips, gentle eyes, and a serene, slightly smiling default expression.
appearance.hair: Vasumitra is a fully shaven monk with smooth scalp and no facial hair; Ashvaghosha has neatly combed, shoulder-length straight dark brown hair parted in the middle, a short well-trimmed beard and moustache, and no headwear.
appearance.costume: Vasumitra wears an early Kushan‑era Sarvāstivāda monk’s robe: a saffron‑orange inner tunic fully covering chest, arms and legs, wrapped with a deep maroon outer sanghati draped over the left shoulder and under the right arm, the cloth rendered as medium-weight wool with subtle horizontal weaving; he has simple dark brown leather sandals and a plain wooden prayer bead bracelet on his left wrist. Ashvaghosha wears a scholar-monk’s layered robe: a long-sleeved, cream cotton under‑tunic tied with a narrow dark brown belt, over which a light grey-beige woolen upper robe is wrapped and secured, with a rich indigo-blue outer shawl draped over both shoulders and flowing to mid-calf, the edges finished in a thin muted gold border; he also wears dark brown sandals and a small, neatly tied cloth pouch at his belt.
appearance.signature: Vasumitra carries a rolled birchbark scroll bound with a simple dark red cord in his left hand, while Ashvaghosha holds a slim wooden writing tablet and stylus together in his right hand.

ref_desc: Vasumitra is a shaven Gandharan monk in saffron and deep maroon robes with a birchbark scroll, beside Ashvaghosha, a shoulder-length dark-haired bearded scholar in cream, grey-beige and indigo robes holding a wooden tablet and stylus, both wearing dark brown sandals.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character pair of Vasumitra and Ashvaghosha from Kushan-era Kashmir-Gandhara: Vasumitra is a lean, shaven monk in his late 40s with an oval light brown face, sharp nose and quietly intense eyes, wearing a fully covering saffron-orange inner tunic and a deep maroon woolen sanghati draped over his left shoulder, simple dark brown sandals, and a plain wooden bead bracelet, holding a rolled birchbark scroll bound with a dark red cord in his left hand; beside him stands Ashvaghosha, slightly younger with a medium brown complexion, softer oval face, gentle eyes, neatly combed shoulder-length straight dark brown hair parted in the middle, a short well-trimmed beard and moustache, dressed in a long-sleeved cream cotton under-tunic tied with a narrow dark brown belt, a light grey-beige woolen upper robe, and an indigo-blue outer shawl with a thin muted gold border draped over both shoulders down to mid-calf, wearing dark brown sandals and a small cloth pouch at his belt, holding a slim wooden writing tablet and stylus in his right hand; show them standing together front-facing, full-length, with clear view of faces, hair, layered robes, footwear, and their scholarly props, using saffron orange, deep maroon, indigo blue, cream, light grey-beige, and dark brown as the dominant colours.
